§bGTNH Greenhouse§r

A 5x5x4 multiblock that grows CropsNH crops, AgriCraft/Pam's plants and trees (including Forestry breeding).

§eModes§r (screwdriver or GUI): §bHarvest§r (crop drops), §bPollination§r (cross-breed new seed types), §bGrowth§r (raise seed stats).
§eSeed Bed Hatch§r: one seed per slot with its own under-soil block; LV is 2x2, each tier adds a row and column (8x8 from ZPM). It can't be a higher tier than the energy hatch.
§eFertilizer§r goes in a normal input bus; drops come out of the output bus.

§cRebalanced§r: Harvest uses Distilled Water (Purified Water from ZPM) and Sewage, Pollination uses Mutagen, Growth is slow and uses fertilizer. Plants per slot go from 4 at LV to 32 at UIV. The mod also adds the Soul Crusher (Chapter 1).

§aTask§r: tick the box once you've read this.
